import numpy as np

def attention_forward(Q, K, V):
    d = Q.shape[1]
    scale = 1.0 / np.sqrt(d)
    S = (Q @ K.T) * scale
    S_max = np.max(S, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp_S = np.exp(S - S_max)
    P = exp_S / np.sum(exp_S, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    out = P @ V
    cache = (Q, K, V, P, scale)
    return out, cache

def attention_backward(dout, cache):
    Q, K, V, P, scale = cache
    dP = dout @ V.T
    dV = P.T @ dout
    dS = P * (dP - np.sum(dP * P, axis=1, keepdims=True))
    dQ = scale * (dS @ K)
    dK = scale * (dS.T @ Q)
    return dQ, dK, dV
